memos.argument: Halloween/dress-up costume sets with crown, necklace, sunglasses, flower are festive/entertainment articles. CROSS G89981 notes the festive-article treatment (9505.90.60) for costumes of flimsy construction not normal apparel; sets with plastic accessories can be argued as a whole to be festive. Weakness: that ruling itself rejected 9505 for well-made garments.
exclusions_against: Ch. 95 note 1(e) excludes fancy dress of textiles of chapter 61 or 62
Ch. 95 note 1(x) excludes apparel with utilitarian function
G89981 held well-constructed blouse/pant/vest are apparel, not 9505
Princess dress rulings (H80172, H82907) classified costumes in ch. 61

memos.argument: Princess costume set: the long dress gives essential character under GRI 3(b); H80172 classified a Princess Costume (dress, crown, etc.) in 6104.43.2020 girls' knit synthetic dresses; H82053 and H82907 similar. Ch. 95 note 1(e) sends textile fancy dress to ch. 61/62. Applies to knit dress; fabric knit/woven not stated. Hippie set pants/blouse/vest could be 6104.63 per G89981 if knit.
exclusions_against: Knit vs woven not stated; if woven the dress is 6204
Hippie costume has mixed materials; G89981 put the woven set in 6206/6210 and pants in 6104.63 variously
Retail set with non-textile accessories; GRI 3(b) essential character needed

memos.argument: Same costume-as-apparel logic if the dress is woven synthetic: ch. 95 note 1(e) routes fancy dress to ch. 62; H82053 put a woven polyester costume dress in 6204.43.4040 and H82907 also cited 6204.43.4040. Hippie set (blouse, pants, vest) of woven fabric would also sit in ch. 62 (G89981 woven blouse/pant/vest in 6206/6204-type headings). Leaf code from ruling citation, not navigated.
exclusions_against: Fabric construction unknown; if knit, 6104 applies
Ch. 95 note 1(e) only excludes; set-with-accessories needs GRI 3(b)
